summary: Last 个股 case studies (book pp.197-207). Finishes 元太 (main player distributing at a multi-year neckline support; short on the head confirmation, cross-checked with a H&S top count), then 裕日车 daily (two nested measured moves after prior-high breakouts), 宏达电 weekly (fundamental change shows up as 破底翻; V reversal + false breakout + 价跌资增 as the short; 威盛 monthly as a warning), 苹果 2010 daily (false-breakout sell, symmetric time-wave 'danger period', 破底翻 reversal = time correction) and 苹果 2012 daily (upside target, price-volume divergence, false breakout; a later false breakout with 价跌量增 = real bear).

patterns.name_zh: 头肩顶 / 颈线支撑压低出货
patterns.name_en: Head-and-shoulders top at the main player's distribution neckline
patterns.structure: 元太: three lows over ~2 years 4 months form a big neckline near 35; the main player distributes there for ~4 months. Short side: break of a half-month range low after the head (55.94). The same chart can be counted as a H&S top (left shoulder 56.58, head 66.68, right shoulder 65.31, neckline ~52.6 below the head, break ~57.5).
patterns.entry: Short on 翻黑破线 head confirmation (2011-11-16), ~55.9, when the half-month range low 55.94 breaks.

target.formula: Swing method: rebound_high - (high - first_low). H&S method: d = head - neckline_below_head; T1 = break - d; T2 = T1 - d.

confirmation: 库存余额 falls continuously after the false breakout
Both counting methods give nearly the same target
invalidation: 破底翻 at the target = cover

patterns.name_zh: 突破前高 涨幅满足（嵌套大波段）
patterns.name_en: Prior-high breakout measured move, nested larger wave
patterns.structure: 裕日车: once price breaks the prior high, add the first swing (low→high) to the later higher low. After the target and a ~31% correction, a volume 破底翻 + volume neckline breakout + new high triggers a larger-wave count from the original low to the new high.
patterns.entry: Volume long red breaking the neckline (2010-04-07) and the new high on 2010-04-08; hold while neckline support 74 holds.
patterns.stop: Neckline support 74 (implied: hold while it is unbroken).
confirmation: Volume on the 破底翻 (2010-03-03) and breakout
Breaking the prior high 82.6 with volume
invalidation: Long black candle breaking the head neckline (2010-04-30) = weakness confirmed

patterns.name_zh: V型反转 + 假突破 + 价跌资增
patterns.name_en: V-reversal top after a false breakout, with falling price and rising margin
patterns.structure: 宏达电 weekly: a weekly volume black candle breaks both the neckline and the rising trendline after a false breakout; the decline retraces the whole rally (V reversal) and breaks the swing's starting low 207.08. Margin rises while price falls and inventory drops (筹码越跌越乱).
patterns.entry: Short at the weekly confirmation (2011-06-18 week), ~900.

target.formula: n.a. — exit on the 破底翻 cover signal (2012-11-17 week, ~248)

confirmation: 价跌资增 and falling 库存 (inventory)
Break of the swing's starting low
invalidation: Volume reclaim of the line (破底翻)

patterns.name_zh: 假突破 → 对称时间波危险期 → 破底翻（以盘代跌）
patterns.name_en: False-breakout sell, symmetric time-wave danger period, break-bottom reversal (time correction)
patterns.structure: After a false-breakout sell signal, measure the consolidation time to the left of the high; the same span to the right is the danger period. A break below the range during the danger period is a short; a volume reclaim at the end of the danger period (破底翻) means the correction was taken in time rather than price, so flip long.
patterns.entry: Short when price breaks the range low (苹果 ~239, 6 trading days before 9/1); flip long on the volume 破底翻 reclaim (9/1, ~252).
patterns.stop: Short: 252 (back above the line), risk ~5.5%. Long: near the low (falling back below the line), risk ~6%.
confirmation: The break of the range is on light volume while the reclaim is on heavier volume = chips stably changed hands
Reclaim coincides with the end of the symmetric danger period
invalidation: Falling back below the line after the 破底翻

patterns.name_zh: 涨幅满足 + 量价背离 + 假突破；价跌量增空头
patterns.name_en: Upside target with price-volume divergence and false breakout; falling price with rising volume = bear
patterns.structure: 苹果 2012: rally with rising volume, peak volume, then about a month of rising price on shrinking volume (divergence) into the measured-move target; a black-candle false breakout confirms the top. If the following pullback holds the neckline with shrinking volume through the symmetric danger period, it's a time correction (以盘代跌). A later false breakout followed by falling price on rising volume is a real bear move.
patterns.entry: Long: 2011-12-20 long red candle breaking the neckline, ~396. Short after the 2012-09-25 false breakout, ~674.

target.worked_example: 526.2-377.68=148.52; 486.63+148.52=635.15 (high 644). Short target 395 from a swing downside count (inputs not shown); actual low 385 on 2013-04-19.

confirmation: ①价涨量增 → ②价量背离 near the target → false breakout
③价跌量增 after the sell signal = 筹码渐乱 bear

rules.rule: A big multi-year neckline formed by several lows is where the main player distributes; for institutions, the neckline support zone is the biggest trap.
rules.quote_zh: 三个低点连接形成长达约两年四个月的大颈线，支撑约在35元附近，主力就在此处震荡出货达约四个月之久。

rules.rule: The best short is at the head confirmation (翻黑破线), which is also where the main player's second wave of distribution starts.
rules.quote_zh: 最佳空点在翻黑破线头部确立时，也是主力第二波出货起始点。

rules.rule: A rebound that fails and then breaks the rebound low lets you compute the swing downside target.
rules.quote_zh: 当股价自43.03元反弹后，再跌破反弹低点43.03元，便可计算跌幅满足

rules.rule: Short entry is the break of the half-month-plus range low; stop on reclaiming the line; cover at the target or on a 破底翻.
rules.quote_zh: 通常跌破整理半个多月整理区的低点55.94元，确立翻空，约可空在55.9元附近，停损设59元也就是站回线上时，风险约5.5%。

rules.rule: The same shape can also be counted as a H&S top with the same short point; both counts agreed.
rules.quote_zh: 同样的图形也可以头肩顶作计算，空点相同。

rules.rule: Reaching the first-wave target typically triggers a sharp short-term escape rebound.
rules.quote_zh: 元太达第一波跌幅满足附近（最低43.03元），便开始短线急弹，作逃命反弹。

rules.rule: After a correction, a volume 破底翻 + neckline breakout + new high allows a bigger-wave target from the original low.
rules.quote_zh: 隔日4月8日再度长红且带量突破新高（前高82.6元），此时便可计算涨幅满足。这次计算的是更大波段的涨幅满足。

rules.rule: After the neckline breakout, while neckline support holds, look for the swing target.
rules.quote_zh: 在突破颈线后，不破颈线支撑74元上看波段涨幅满足110.7元。

rules.rule: Fundamental change shows up in the technicals (e.g. 宏达电's switch to capacitive touch → 破底翻 buy).
rules.quote_zh: 自从产品改用电容式触控后，股价在技术面也出现破底翻的买进信号，所以基本面的改变会反应在技术面上。

rules.rule: V reversals mostly occur in speculative stocks; when a leader V-reverses and breaks the swing's starting low it usually signals long-term decline — at best a long consolidation (trading time for space).
rules.quote_zh: 通常V型反转大多出现在投机股上……而且大波段起涨的低点207.08元也被跌破，这种情况通常都是公司长期衰退的征兆，最好的情况唯有长期整理，以时间换取空间。

rules.rule: 价跌资增 with steadily falling inventory means chips get more chaotic as price falls — bearish.
rules.quote_zh: 筹码面明显价跌资增且库存持续大减，表示筹码越跌越乱

rules.rule: One signal can flip a position: the false-breakout break both takes profit on longs and opens a short.
rules.quote_zh: 假突破翻空确立，多单获利了结，约可卖在900元，波段获利约226%，同时翻多为空，约可空在900元，停损设在940元附近也就是站回线上时，风险约4.5%。

rules.rule: After a false-breakout sell signal the stock either consolidates or falls (非盘即跌); the danger period equals the consolidation time to the left of the high, mirrored to the right.
rules.quote_zh: 苹果型态上假突破确立后高点往左边的整理时间约两个月（图示紫色虚线部分），此时便可以同样高点计算往右约两个月的对称时间为危险期。

rules.rule: A low-volume break below the range followed by a higher-volume reclaim means chips changed hands stably — the weak structure is reversed.
rules.quote_zh: 这次的破底不带量，但翻回整理区的量较大，表示筹码经过整理后已稳定换手，扭转弱势结构。

rules.rule: Sell signals are followed by a price correction (盘跌/fall) or a time correction (以盘代跌); only strong fundamentals allow a time correction and another leg up.
rules.quote_zh: 当卖出信号出现后大多是非盘即跌，做空间或时间的修正，盘跌是空间的修正，以盘代跌则是时间的修正。有强劲的基本面，股价才能在涨多后经过一段整理期消化不安定的筹码，再攻一波。

rules.rule: On a clear sell signal, exit (or reduce, for long-term holders); re-enter only on a stabilisation signal.
rules.quote_zh: 操作上出现明显卖出信号时，作必要性的退出才能避开风险（对长期操作者而言就是减码的依据），直到企稳信号出现时才做进场布局动作。

rules.rule: When a 破底翻 fires against your short, stop out decisively and flip long.
rules.quote_zh: 空单需果决执行停损进而翻空为多

rules.rule: Rising price on shrinking volume near the target (价量背离) precedes the false-breakout top.
rules.quote_zh: 随后便出现近1个月盘涨的价涨量缩量价背离（②）现象，股价盘涨至涨幅满足附近（最高644）

rules.rule: A sell signal followed by falling price on rising volume is a bear trend with deteriorating chips; one followed by holding the neckline on shrinking volume is a time correction.
rules.quote_zh: 这次的卖出信号后价跌量增为筹码渐乱的空头走势（③），股价随后大跌。

rules.rule: Tech stocks are driven by innovation; when innovation falters it shows in the technicals (Microsoft, Cisco precedents) — be careful with risk.
rules.quote_zh: 科技股的股价动力来自于创新，一旦创新能力不足便会反应在技术面上，反之亦然，微软、思科等皆有前例可循，这说明股票市场要小心注意风险。

rules.rule: Master quotes (Kostolany): profit only comes from carefully analysing failures; a speculator needs capital, patience, strong nerves, independent thinking, experience and sharp eyes.
rules.quote_zh: 只有仔细分析失败，才能从中获利；只有惨败才会让人回到现实。／投机家的条件：资金、耐心、坚强的神经、独立思考、经验丰富与敏锐眼光。

quantifiable: Danger period: t_left = bars from consolidation start to the false-breakout high; danger window = [high_bar, high_bar + t_left]. A 破底翻 at/after its end is a long.
Volume asymmetry for 破底翻: volume on the breakdown bar < volume on the reclaim bar.
Price-volume divergence: over ~20 bars, close trending up while volume (e.g. a 20-day mean) trends down, near a measured-move target.
After a sell signal: if the next N bars show falling close + rising volume → bear; if close stays >= neckline with falling volume through the danger window → time correction.
Swing downside target: rebound_high - (prior_high - first_low), triggered by a close below the first low after the rebound.
Short entry: close below the low of a >=10-bar consolidation after the head; stop = close back above the line.
V-reversal danger: decline breaks the starting low of the whole rally → treat as long-term decline.
Chip filter (Taiwan data): margin balance (融资) rising while price falls, plus main-player inventory falling → bearish.
ambiguities: 元太 swing count uses high 65.31 (right shoulder) rather than the head 66.68; the reason isn't explained.
宏达电 cover 248 vs chart low 191.00 — the 破底翻 reclaim level vs the extreme low; profit 72% is computed from 900→248.
苹果 2012 short target 395: inputs for the swing downside count are not shown on these pages.
Danger-period length is eyeballed ('约两个月'); the start of the left consolidation is not defined.
苹果 2010 pullback ~15% — no anchor prices given in the text.
裕日车 neckline support 74 is cited without the neckline being labelled on the chart.
